exact_contract: Under the registered Gaussian target assumption, verify the exact decomposition of excess population risk into orthogonal representation approximation error and task-specific optimization error, then vary upstream N and target K2 separately.

assumptions.upstream: Exact delta=0 RIP design and balanced kappa=1 truth.
assumptions.target: x~N(0,I), hence H=I and E[xx^T M xx^T]=2M+tr(M)I <=3tr(M)I for PSD M.

pass_rule: Maximum decomposition residual <=1e-12, both resource-slope confidence intervals contain -1, and the zero-projection negative control exceeds 1e-4.
implementation_convention: Algorithm 2 pseudocode with h=0; the paper does not instantiate h.
